description: Configure the 'Default Deployment Repository' for the virtual repository 'libs-virtual'. Currently, this virtual repository aggregates 'example-repo-local', but it does not allow deployment because no target is selected. Log in to Artifactory (http://localhost:8082, admin/password), navigate to the 'libs-virtual' configuration in the Administration module, and set the 'Default Deployment Repository' to 'example-repo-local'. Save the changes.
